gaps.statement: ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = 4

plain_statement.en: 4 is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = 10

plain_statement.en: 10 is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = 18

plain_statement.en: 18 is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n) → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p ≤ q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 若一个自然数可写成两个素数之和，则可选取一组使第一个素数不大于第二个。
plain_statement.en: If a natural number is a sum of two primes, it has such a representation with the first prime at most the second.

gaps.statement: ∀ n p q : ℕ, 4 < n → Even n → Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → p + q = n → Odd p ∧ Odd q

plain_statement.zh: 大于 4 的偶数若写成两个素数之和，则这两个素数都是奇数。
plain_statement.en: In any representation of an even natural number greater than 4 as two primes, both primes are odd.
